scientific_integrity: All claimed infinite-dimensional statements have analytic proofs. Independent finite Fourier and product calculations provide corroboration rather than certificates of global uniqueness. The underlying graph Hamiltonian and commuting involutions are credited to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Results are for the countable finite-subset hypercube with geometric weights \(2^{-(k+1)}\), the empty initial vertex and singleton targets. Unique global maximizing time is proved for all sufficiently large target indices, not for every finite index. No robustness, perturbation, or first-passage claims. Broad literature priority is not independently established.
title: Sharp high-coordinate transfer and self-similar resonances on a dyadic infinite hypercube
